title: Variance exceeds the weighted influence sum
statement: Let $f$ be the specified real-valued function on the three-dimensional cube of signs, and let $T$ be its specified zero-error randomized decision tree. Under the uniform distribution on the sign cube, the sum over coordinates of the probability that $T$ queries that coordinate, multiplied by the coordinate influence of $f$, is strictly less than the variance of $f$. Here coordinate influence is the expected square of the difference between $f$ and its average over that coordinate.
